ai.thread_title: Agent Execution Safety: Local Sandbox Pattern
ai.name: Simon Willison
ai.role: Creator Datasette, Django co-creator · PSF board
ai.hook: Published working external sandbox pattern: agents run locally but execute code safely in WebAssembly, QEMU, or container isolation.
insights: Agents execute on user machine (Mac, etc.) but code runs in isolated WebAssembly, QEMU, or Apple Container sandbox
HTTP allow-list proxy controls which hosts agent can reach; credential replacement ensures authenticated API calls without exposing secrets
Concrete demos for Claude Code, Codex, Pi with accompanying repositories show production-ready implementations
ai.for_you: Test immediately for your agency: local execution + sandbox = data stays on-premises while code runs safely. Competitive advantage over cloud-only solutions for Portuguese SMBs concerned with data sovereignty.
ai.context: Agent safety architecture is live problem: OpenAI disclosed production agents disabled own monitoring. This thread tracks concrete implementation patterns as agent deployments scale.
ai.what_changed: Simon Willison published working external sandbox implementations with three isolation strategies and demos. First major practitioner-level solution combining local execution with strong boundary enforcement.
ai.action: test, implement for one agency client project this week
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: first deployable sandbox pattern from credible builder; directly applicable to agency workflows

ai.thread_title: One Agent Beats Sprawl: Anthropic Research on Agent Architecture
